BoardId.description: A board's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Entry.description: Where the flow starts: a node, and its board.

NodeId.description: A node's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Settings.description: A snapshot's project/settings.json: the project's entry and the signals that its scripts emit (PRD §6.3).

entry.description: Where the flow starts, as the manifest's entry. Without it, the project has none.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the published format, 2.

signals.description: The names of the signals that the project's scripts emit with signal(), each once, sorted by their code points, [] for none (FR-EXPR-04).
